name: Scrolling Text Marquee
summary: Progressively enhanced ordered content strip with an authoritative native list, static fallback, distance-normalized logical motion, one inert visual copy, and canonical Button pause/resume.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Generic root, or section when the optional visible label names it; omitted when no valid items exist.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual label; its id labels a section root.

anatomy.name: viewport
anatomy.description: Clipped visual viewport only after Auto enhancement; overflow remains readable in every static fallback.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Presentation track animated by CSS after bounded distance measurement.

anatomy.name: sourceGroup
anatomy.description: The one authoritative native list in target-authored order.

anatomy.name: visualCopy
anatomy.description: At most one runtime-created visual copy, aria-hidden, inert, non-interactive and absent from the semantic data source.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item containing one concise target-owned phrase or composed mark.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Canonical compact outline Button revealed only for a valid Auto enhancement and labelled with the next Pause or Resume action.

variants.name: auto
variants.description: Starts logical continuous motion when enhancement is valid and the user has not requested reduced motion.

variants.name: static
variants.description: Readable intrinsic wrapping list with no visual copy, motion control or component runtime work.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One container-responsive presentation; type, gaps and track geometry remain private.

states.name: static
states.description: Authored list wraps normally and no motion control is available.

states.name: pending
states.description: No-JavaScript and pre-enhancement Auto markup stays readable and static.

states.name: playing
states.description: CSS track animation runs at the measured duration for the selected semantic pace.

states.name: temporarilyPaused
states.description: Pointer presence suspends motion without changing the durable user preference.

states.name: userPaused
states.description: Focus entry or Pause activation creates a durable pause until explicit Resume.

states.name: hiddenPaused
states.description: Animation work is suspended while the document is hidden.

states.name: reducedMotion
states.description: The source list is static, the visual copy is hidden and the motion control is omitted.

behavior.name: progressiveEnhancement
behavior.description: Invalid, empty, one-item, static, reduced-motion, or failed enhancement preserves the source list and does not expose an inert control.

behavior.name: boundedVisualDuplication
behavior.description: Runtime creates at most one exact visual copy from the authoritative list, removes duplicate ids, makes descendants unfocusable, and marks the complete copy aria-hidden and inert.

behavior.name: distanceNormalizedPace
behavior.description: A shared ResizeObserver performs bounded initialization/resize measurements and maps slow, default, or fast to private pixels-per-second velocities; CSS owns every animation frame.

behavior.name: logicalDirection
behavior.description: Forward moves toward inline-start and reveals subsequent content from inline-end; physical travel reverses automatically in RTL.

behavior.name: pauseResume
behavior.description: Canonical Button toggles durable pause; hover pauses temporarily; focus entering durably pauses; hidden documents suspend; only explicit Resume clears the user pause.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Neutral Web is uncontrolled for the live component lifetime. Framework adapters may project controlled state around the same state and event without adding a second owner.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: Auto progressive motion or an explicitly static presentation.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional visible contextual label; blank omits both the label and section landmark.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One authoritative ordered native list of at least one concise target-owned item; Auto enhancement requires at least two.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Logical motion direction independent of physical left/right.

properties.name: pace
properties.description: Semantic distance-normalized velocity preset; raw duration remains private.

properties.name: pauseLabel
properties.description: Localized visible next-action label used while Auto motion can be paused.

properties.name: resumeLabel
properties.description: Localized visible next-action label used while Auto motion is durably paused.

accessibility: Keep one authoritative native list in meaningful target-authored order and hide every visual copy from accessibility APIs and focus navigation.
Do not use Marquee as the only location for critical policy, price, availability, status, deadline, instruction or error information.
Expose one localized canonical Button for persistent Pause and Resume whenever Auto enhancement is active.
Pause durably when focus enters, temporarily while hovered, and while the document is hidden; never announce frames, loop boundaries or visual copies.
Render a readable static list and omit the motion control for reduced motion, missing JavaScript, failed enhancement, invalid content or one item.
Preserve logical order, keyboard access, visible focus, RTL direction, forced colors, localization, narrow containers and 200 percent text zoom.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and shared progressive runtime provide bounded duplication, measurement, playback state and Button control.

shopify.notes: Map ordered blocks and semantic settings to the same static baseline and storefront enhancement; editor preview remains static until target implementation is certified.
